home.tagline: I design and ship product-grade web apps — from polished interfaces to the APIs that power them.
home.aboutLead: Frontend-oriented full-stack developer with 3 years of commercial experience.
home.aboutBody: I work full-time as a Consultant at Awumba, building nearshore software for clients across React, Next.js, and .NET. Outside of that role I build my own products — SpendBeacon and Lekcjo — and occasionally take on small personal commissions in the evenings and on weekends: marketing pages, landing sites, and compact web systems. My day job always comes first.
home.workSubtitle: Products I’ve built end-to-end — product, frontend, and backend.

experience.description: Full-stack delivery for nearshore clients — React, Next.js, .NET, cloud integrations, and product UI.
Shipped responsive interfaces, component systems, and feature work across commercial projects.
Built a full-stack finance SaaS: Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AI categorization, Stripe billing, and PL/EN i18n.
Built a tutoring platform with scheduling, online classroom, shared notes, and homework — for solo tutors and small schools.

home.ctaBandTitle: Small project for evenings or a weekend?
home.ctaBandBody: Outside my full-time role I’m selectively open to personal commissions — marketing pages, landings, small systems, and scoped MVPs. Work happens in my free time only; capacity is limited and timelines stay honest.

spendbeacon.name: SpendBeacon
spendbeacon.tagline: Personal finance, budgets & bank CSV import
spendbeacon.description: A full-stack SaaS that turns bank CSV/Excel exports into clear spending insights. Free rules-based categorization; Premium AI maps unusual layouts, auto-categorizes merchants, and answers questions about your money.
features: CSV/Excel import for any bank (mBank, PKO BP, ING, and more)
Rules-based and AI categorization with learning from corrections
Safe-to-spend, budgets, subscription radar, and alerts
AI finance coach with merchant-level reports
Stripe subscriptions, JWT/OAuth auth, PWA, PL/EN i18n

lekcjo.name: Lekcjo
lekcjo.tagline: Schedule, notes, and lessons in one place
lekcjo.description: A platform for tutors and their students — booking, online classroom, and materials together. Parents pick open slots, lessons happen with video, board, and notebook in one window, and homework lands where it belongs — not in a chat thread.
features: Scheduling with open slots parents can book
Online lesson room: video, board, and notebook
Lesson notes and homework shared with the student
Built for solo tutors and small schools — no marketplace fees
Clear pricing: Solo and School plans

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Personal commissions for evenings & weekends — or a quick hello.
contact.success: Message sent — I’ll get back to you soon.
contact.findBody: Prefer socials or email? Reach me directly.

appointments.title: Book a time
appointments.subtitle: Request a call for an evening or a weekend. I’ll confirm or decline by email.
appointments.availability: Start times are weekday evenings 17:00–20:00 and weekends 10:00–18:00, Europe/Warsaw. Nothing is held until I accept.
appointments.name: Your name
appointments.successBody: You’ll get an email when I accept or decline. The time isn’t reserved yet.
appointments.noSlots: No open slots left on this day. Try another date.

errors.invalid: Check the form and try again.
errors.invalid-time: That time isn’t available. Pick another slot.
errors.rate: Too many requests. Try again in a little while.
errors.email-config: Email isn’t configured yet. Write to me directly instead.
errors.unexpected: Couldn’t send the request. Try again, or email me directly.

respond.chooseTitle: What should happen with this request?
respond.acceptBody: Accepting adds it to your Google Calendar and emails them a confirmation.
respond.rejectBody: Declining emails them that this time doesn’t work. The slot stays free.
respond.chooseBody: Accept to put it on your calendar, or decline and they’ll get an email.
respond.note: Note to include in their email (optional)
respond.invalidBody: The link is incomplete or has been changed.
respond.expiredBody: Appointment links stay valid for 14 days. Ask them to send a new request.

done.acceptedBody: The appointment is on Google Calendar, and a confirmation email is on its way.
done.rejectedBody: They’ve been emailed that this time doesn’t work.
done.already-acceptedBody: This request was already added to your calendar.
done.calendar-missingBody: Nothing was changed. Connect Calendar, then open the email and accept again.
done.accepted-email-failedTitle: On your calendar, but the email failed
done.accepted-email-failedBody: The event was created. The confirmation email didn’t send — write to them directly.
done.rejected-email-failedBody: The request is marked declined. The email didn’t send — tell them yourself.
done.expiredBody: Appointment links stay valid for 14 days.
done.invalidBody: The link is incomplete or has been changed.
done.errorBody: Nothing was finalized. Open the email and try the button again.
